About us

A high-performance engineering partner based in Alexandria.

Founded in 2016 in Alexandria, Egypt, Sintech for Engineering Supplies and Trade is a high-performance engineering company specializing in turnkey industrial and construction projects.

We deliver fully integrated solutions covering design, global procurement, installation, and commissioning, with a strong focus on industrial facilities and factory setups.

With proven experience across Egypt, Turkey, and Sudan, Sintech combines engineering expertise, international sourcing capability, and fast execution to meet the most demanding project requirements.

Sense of quality Trust Business ethic Responsibility Experience

"Unconditional customer satisfaction is our principle."

Mission

To deliver reliable engineering products and services that meet international standards, while ensuring customer satisfaction through professionalism, timely delivery, and competitive pricing.

Vision

To become a leading engineering supply and solutions provider in the Middle East and Africa, recognized for quality, innovation, and long-term partnerships.

Core activities

Seven disciplines, one accountable contractor.

Sintech covers the full scope of an industrial build — so clients manage one contract, not seven.

Turnkey Industrial & Construction Projects

End-to-end delivery from design through commissioning, for factories and industrial facilities.

Mechanical Systems & Installations

Mechanical installation and integration across industrial and commercial facilities.

Electrical Systems & Panel Solutions

MV/LV distribution, switchgear, and custom panel builds for industrial power needs.

Fire Fighting & Fire Alarm Systems

Fire suppression, foam systems, and alarm networks engineered to code.

Piping Systems & Infrastructure

Process and utility piping infrastructure for industrial and commercial sites.

Steel Fabrication & Structural Works

Structural steel, mezzanines, and fabrication for new-build and expansion projects.

Construction & Finishing Works

Civil works and finishing to bring facilities to full operational readiness.
